messages:
Vera N.: FYI we're launching a small experiment to defer assignment briefly while enrichment runs. Goal: fewer misassigned leads and cleaner attribution. Canary 10% in 20m.
Sam K.: What's the defer window and fallback behavior?
Ibrahim A.: Defer window = 30s. If enrichment not complete -> fallback to Overflow RR and set properties: fallback_reason=ENRICH_TIMEOUT, fallback_via=RR, experiment_tag=defer_orch. Also set fallback_notified=false initially.
Lina M.: Docs action: update the handoff playbook with the new property names and add example HubSpot workflow.
Sam K.: HubSpot workflow snippet for docs:
```
Trigger: Contact created
Delay: 30s
If property(enriched) == true -> Smart assign owner
Else -> Assign queue "Overflow RR"; set properties(fallback_reason=ENRICH_TIMEOUT, fallback_via=RR, experiment_tag=defer_orch)
```
SDR Oncall: SDRs noted. We'll suppress drip emails for experiment_tag leads until owner confirmed.
Ibrahim A.: Salesforce mapping: add boolean Fallback__c and Text Fallback_Via__c, keep Original_Owner__c empty on fallback so conversion attribution stays to system queue.
Vera N.: Observability: watch assign_latency_p95, enrichment_completion_rate, fallback_rate. Alert if fallback_rate > 0.10 for 15m -> page #marketing-oncall.
Sam K.: Also we should jitter the RR fallback so it's fair: add small random delay of 2-6s in the overflow assign webhook to avoid claim storms.
Ibrahim A.: Good call. We'll include jitter and set webhook payload to include fallback_notified=true when queue assignment completes.
HubSpot Bot: Workflow "Defer Orchestration Canary" created by Vera N. (ID: 40321)
Lina M.: Runbook before start: mute expected alerts, verify webhook secrets, publish quick rollback toggle in feature flags, notify SDR rotation.
Vera N.: Rolling in 20m. I'll post the dashboard link and a 15m check-in cadence. Keep chat replies minimal during the run. :rocket:
